name: io.github.doublegate/cyberchef-mcp
description: CyberChef's 504 data-transformation operations -- encryption, encoding, compression, forensics -- as MCP tools, with prompts for common analysis workflows.
_comment: The npm package record is deliberately absent: cyberchef-mcp is publishable as of v2.3.0 -- the install script it used to need is gone, and a --ignore-scripts install of the packed tarball starts and serves -- but it has not been published yet. Advertising a package that is not on the registry would send clients to an install that 404s. Add the record in the same change that publishes it. See docs/releases/v2.3.0.md.
